say:0:1423128001:0.text: Both Hyla and Ironbeard are here. It's time to set out for Sal'thorin.
say:0:1423128001:0.source_cn: 海拉和铁须都到齐了，可以前往萨洛克兰了。
say:0:1423128001:0.male: Both Hyla and Ironbeard are here. It's time to set out for Sal'thorin.
say:0:1423128001:0.female: Both Hyla and Ironbeard are here. It's time to set out for Sal'thorin.

say:2:1423130001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.
say:2:1423130001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.
say:2:1423130001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I spoke with Indris, and we've decided to move forward with our collaboration today.

say:3:1423130002:1.text: So soon? I'm not getting involved unless I know for sure they're trustworthy.
say:3:1423130002:1.source_cn: 怎么这就要正式合作了？如果不能确定他们彻底可信，我是不...

say:4:1423130003:1.text: Relax, Indris will show you around Sal'thorin so you can get a clearer picture of things.
say:4:1423130003:1.source_cn: 放心，因度厄会带你参观萨洛克兰，了解萨洛克兰现在的情况...

say:5:1423130004:1.text: If anything doesn't sit right with you during the negotiation, just speak up anytime.
say:5:1423130004:1.source_cn: 商谈开始后，如果不满意他们提出的条件，你也能随时叫停。

say:7:1423130006:1.text: Indris is probably waiting at the <style="highlight">lift shaft</style> already. Why don't you guys head out first? I'll join you once I wrap up my things here.
say:7:1423130006:1.source_cn: 因度厄应该已经在<style=highlight>王城...

say:8:1423130007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we dwarves are a straightforward bunch. If the discussion later turns sour, I might need you to step in and smooth things over.
say:8:1423130007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we dwarves are a straightforward bunch. If the discussion later turns sour, I might need you to step in and smooth things over.
say:8:1423130007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we dwarves are a straightforward bunch. If the discussion later turns sour, I might need you to step in and smooth things over.

say:0:1423131001:0.text: You guys must be the representatives from Brimstone Village.
say:0:1423131001:0.source_cn: 诸位就是前来商议魔钢合作的矮人代表吧。

say:3:1423132001:1.text: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?
say:3:1423132001:1.male: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?
say:3:1423132001:1.female: Fancy seeing you again, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. And this must be Hyla. We met briefly before, didn't we?

say:4:1423132002:1.text: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!
say:4:1423132002:1.source_cn: 上次的事还要多谢你……对了，向你介绍一下我们矮人代表团...
say:4:1423132002:1.male: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!
say:4:1423132002:1.female: I really appreciate your help last time... Now, let me introduce our delegation—myself, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Ironbeard!

say:5:1423132003:1.text: Ironbeard's the most respected craftsman in our village. I'm sure he'll provide plenty of... valuable insights during our discussion!
say:5:1423132003:1.source_cn: 铁须可是深岩村里最有威望的工匠，相信他一定能为我们的商...

say:6:1423132004:1.text: Hmph, enough of the pleasantries. Let's get straight to the point.
say:6:1423132004:1.source_cn: 哼，有事说事，别摆这些花花架子。

say:8:1423132006:1.text: She's taking care of some urgent matters and will join us later.
say:8:1423132006:1.source_cn: 祖娅手头还有些急事要处理，要等会儿才能过来了。

say:9:1423132007:1.text: How about I give you a tour of the royal city first? We can get to know each other and build some trust.
say:9:1423132007:1.source_cn: 那我先带你们逛逛王城吧，海拉和铁须，你们二位应该对萨洛...

say:10:1423132008:1.text: So this place played a role in Eldric's schemes, didn't it? I've got to see it for myself.
say:10:1423132008:1.source_cn: 那我就亲眼看看，和弗林一起搞出那么多阴谋的究竟是个什么地方。

choice_prompt:11:1423132008.text: So this place played a role in Eldric's schemes, didn't it? I've got to see it for myself.
choice_prompt:11:1423132008.source_cn: 那我就亲眼看看，和弗林一起搞出那么多阴谋的究竟是个什么地方。

say:0:1423133001:0.text: Here we are... Given the time constraints, I'll just give you a brief tour.
say:0:1423133001:0.source_cn: 这里便是萨洛克兰王城，有广场，市集，演武场，宫殿……时...

say:1:1423133002:0.text: Such a massive city! Our people must have put in an incredible amount of effort to build this...
say:1:1423133002:0.source_cn: 规模这么大的王城！为了修这些，矮人得出多少力啊……

say:2:1423135001:1.text: The priestesses were coming for me... Sorry for the scare, everyone.
say:2:1423135001:1.source_cn: 这些祭司应该是冲我来的……抱歉，让各位受惊了。

say:3:1423135002:0.text: Don't be, we dwarves have seen worse. Why were they after you?
say:3:1423135002:0.source_cn: 受惊倒是没有，我们矮人也是见过世面的。她们为什么要袭击你？

say:4:1423135003:1.text: These priests used to serve under Priestess Velara, who colluded with Eldric.
say:4:1423135003:1.source_cn: 这些祭司之前都是奎茵大祭司的手下，也就是与弗林达成秘密...

say:5:1423135004:1.text: After Velara's defeat, these priests with powerful magic had nowhere to go... Eventually, some of them grew resentful and started a rebellion.
say:5:1423135004:1.source_cn: 奎茵落败后，祭司们身负精深的魔力，却无容身之处……有些...

say:6:1423135005:1.text: Most commoners here can wield magic, but now, many of them are out of work...
say:6:1423135005:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰大多数的平民都能使用魔法，现在大量的平民失业……

say:7:1423135006:1.text: Compared to the priests' rebellion, the people's livelihoods are the more pressing matter at the moment.
say:7:1423135006:1.source_cn: 相比叛乱，更严重的是平民的生活没有着落。

say:8:1423135007:1.text: This is precisely why I'm committed to advancing our collaboration.
say:8:1423135007:1.source_cn: 这也是我想推进合作的原因。

say:9:1423135008:1.text: In other words, you just want money from us.
say:9:1423135008:1.source_cn: 简单点说，就是想从矮人这赚钱了呗。

say:12:1423135010:1.text: Ironbeard! Can you keep those crude comments to yourself?
say:12:1423135010:1.source_cn: 铁须，不该说的你能不能少说点！

choice_prompt:13:1423135010.text: Ironbeard! Can you keep those crude comments to yourself?
choice_prompt:13:1423135010.source_cn: 铁须，不该说的你能不能少说点！

say:14:1423135011:1.text: Okay, okay... At least now I know these priests can use magic.
say:14:1423135011:1.source_cn: 罢了……起码确定了这些祭司会用魔法。

say:15:1423135012:1.source_cn: 走，我们再去其他地方看看。

choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 要是合作成功，肯定会双赢的

say:1:1423136002:0.text: So crowded here... Looks like Sal'thorin has plenty of laborers—that's a leverage we can use to haggle the fee.
say:1:1423136002:0.source_cn: 这么大的广场……看来平时在这生活的人挺多，劳动力不缺，...

say:3:1423137002:1.text: Why is everyone looking so moody?
say:3:1423137002:1.source_cn: 怎么大家看上去脸色不太好的样子？

say:4:1423137003:1.text: Indris, if Ironbeard has said something offensive, don't take it personally. We dwarves have a habit of sounding more blunt than we mean to be.
say:4:1423137003:1.source_cn: 因度厄，矮人都是直性子，要是铁须说了啥不中听的话，你别...

say:6:1423137005:1.text: Will we be dealing with you later in the discussion?
say:6:1423137005:1.source_cn: 等会儿是直接和你商谈合作的事吗？

say:7:1423137006:1.text: Actually, it's Ravion. He's much better at handling negotiations than I am.
say:7:1423137006:1.source_cn: 是沙利叶。涉及利益纠葛的事他比我更加擅长应对。

say:8:1423137007:1.text: It'll be tricky if it's Ravion...
say:8:1423137007:1.source_cn: 是沙利叶的话，考验可就艰巨了啊……

say:9:1423137008:1.text: Ravion's waiting at the Wisteria Hall. Let's head over there now.
say:9:1423137008:1.source_cn: 沙利叶已经在紫藤会见厅等待大家，请大家移步会见厅吧。

say:0:1423138001:0.text: This is Lord Ravion, the representative of Sal'thorin.
say:0:1423138001:0.source_cn: 这位便是代表萨洛克兰出席本次商谈的沙利叶。

say:1:1423138002:0.text: Ravion, these are the representatives from Brimstone Village.
say:1:1423138002:0.source_cn: 沙利叶，这些是代表深岩村出席本次商谈的矮人代表。

say:1:1423139001:0.text: Thank you for traveling such a long way to Sal'thorin.
say:1:1423139001:0.source_cn: 各位代表好，感谢大家不辞奔波来到萨洛克兰。

say:2:1423139002:1.text: I know dwarves don't like beating around the bush, so let's skip the formalities and dive right into the negotiation.
say:2:1423139002:1.source_cn: 我多少知道一些矮人的性格，知道各位心直口快，闲话少叙，...

say:5:1423139004:1.text: Well said, young man! Let's get down to business!
say:5:1423139004:1.source_cn: 小伙子这话说的不错，别拖泥带水的，有什么话都敞开说吧！

say:7:1423139005:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, Brimstone Village needs our help producing arcane steel, right?
say:7:1423139005:1.source_cn: 各位来此的目的是想让拥有魔力的艾塞勒为矿石注魔，以得到...

say:8:1423139006:1.text: In that case, the matter of compensation is something we must settle.
say:8:1423139006:1.source_cn: 那我们就不得不谈谈报酬的问题了。

say:10:1423139008:1.text: Naturally, Brimstone Village must compensate the Essail for their labor.
say:10:1423139008:1.source_cn: 深岩村既然需要艾塞勒付出劳动以得到魔钢，就要付出与之等...

say:11:1423139009:1.text: After all, it takes exceptional focus and control to enchant the ores.
say:11:1423139009:1.source_cn: 毕竟注入魔力不是一项简单的工作，需要杰出的专注与控制力。

say:12:1423139010:1.text: It's something the dwarves aren't capable of, isn't it?
say:12:1423139010:1.source_cn: 矮人正是因为无法注入魔力，才有求于萨洛克兰的吧？

say:13:1423139011:1.text: Indeed, and you know about that too...
say:13:1423139011:1.source_cn: 那是自然，你也清楚，我们矮人不能使用魔力……

say:14:1423139012:1.text: Considering the value of arcane steel and the estimated labor hours, this is the amount of gold we expect from Brimstone Village.
say:14:1423139012:1.source_cn: 结合魔钢的价值与艾塞勒付出的工时，以金币为单位，萨洛克...

say:15:1423139013:1.source_cn: 沙利叶报出了一个天价数字。

say:16:1423139014:1.text: I-It's astronomical! If we pay this sum, we won't be making any profits from our products!
say:16:1423139014:1.source_cn: 这、这太多了！这个数的原料成本，我们造出武器成品来也根...

say:17:1423139015:1.text: We simply can't afford your fee! We've missed some orders because of the echorite shortage, and now we're stuck paying penalties instead of getting final payments from our clients.
say:17:1423139015:1.source_cn: 更何况因为深岩晶短缺，之前的不少订单都没有及时交货，不...

say:18:1423139016:1.text: We can accept deferred payment. After signing the contract, you'll make an initial payment to us. You can then pay the remaining balance from the profits generated from selling the weapons.
say:18:1423139016:1.source_cn: 可以考虑赊欠的形式，先签订合约，交予我方一部分预付款，...

say:19:1423139017:1.text: This seems to be the only way to make the collaboration happen.
say:19:1423139017:1.source_cn: 要想合作达成，只能采用这样的办法了吧。

say:20:1423139018:1.text: What you said isn't wrong, but... it doesn't change anything for us. In the end, we'll still have to shell out the same hefty fee!
say:20:1423139018:1.source_cn: 可是……这样虽然能暂时达成合作，可最后下来不是还要付那...

say:22:1423139019:1.text: That's daylight robbery, you pointy-eared rascal!
say:22:1423139019:1.source_cn: 尖耳朵小子，你真以为我们矮人是要被你宰的肥羊啊！别欺人...

say:23:1423139020:1.text: You need to get this straight—we're offering jobs to your unemployed people! Their livelihoods depend on us!
say:23:1423139020:1.source_cn: 搞清楚，要不是深岩村愿意和你们合作，你们那些失业的平民...

say:24:1423139021:1.text: Plus, who can guarantee your magic will actually work? Doesn't make any sense to pay you before we see results!
say:24:1423139021:1.source_cn: 而且，谁能保证你们注魔后的矿石真的能用？都还没影呢，就...

say:25:1423139022:1.text: If we can't strike a deal here, I'll just take my men elsewhere. We'll find other mages or scout out other mines. Either way, you pointy ears won't see a single dime from us!
say:25:1423139022:1.source_cn: 要是这次合作谈不成，我马上带村里的兄弟们去其他地方，找...

choice_prompt:26:1423139022.text: If we can't strike a deal here, I'll just take my men elsewhere. We'll find other mages or scout out other mines. Either way, you pointy ears won't see a single dime from us!
choice_prompt:26:1423139022.source_cn: 要是这次合作谈不成，我马上带村里的兄弟们去其他地方，找别的魔法师注魔也好，考察别的矿山也好，你们这些尖耳朵绝对赚不到一分好处！

say:28:1423139024:1.text: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s spoken up, I'll make another offer.
say:28:1423139024:1.male: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s spoken up, I'll make another offer.
say:28:1423139024:1.female: Since <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s spoken up, I'll make another offer.

say:29:1423139025:1.text: Ravion makes another quote, this time more reasonable.
say:29:1423139025:1.source_cn: 沙利叶报出了一个还算合理的价格。

say:32:1423139027:1.text: I have a proposal that could tackle both Brimstone Village's financial difficulties and the situation in Sal'thorin at the same time.
say:32:1423139027:1.source_cn: 考虑到深岩村如今资金周转的难处和萨洛克兰的实际情况，我...

say:33:1423139028:1.text: At this moment, Sal'thorin needs resources from the surface far more than cash. Besides, the Essail will rely on our expertise to keep the lifts running and offer guidance for your future trips to the surface.
say:33:1423139028:1.source_cn: 比起钱，如今的萨洛克兰更需要地表的物产与资源，如果以后...

say:34:1423139029:1.text: We can sign the first-phase agreement, where Brimstone Village will provide surface resources equal in value to the advance payment... and we'll offer lift maintenance and guiding services at no extra cost.
say:34:1423139029:1.source_cn: 我们可以先签第一期协议，一期协议中，深岩村提供与预付款...

say:35:1423139030:1.text: Sounds great! This solution is truly a win-win for both sides...
say:35:1423139030:1.source_cn: 感谢你的诚意，这确实是能让我们双赢的办法……

say:36:1423139031:1.text: In return, I'll grant you the right to use the land in front of the lift shaft for your business.
say:36:1423139031:1.source_cn: 作为回报，我可以将王城升降井前的土地借给深岩村，作为给...

choice_prompt:37:1423139031.text: In return, I'll grant you the right to use the land in front of the lift shaft for your business.
choice_prompt:37:1423139031.source_cn: 作为回报，我可以将王城升降井前的土地借给深岩村，作为给矿石注魔的施工用地。

say:38:1423139032:1.text: That's how negotiations work—things get positive when both sides stand to gain.
say:38:1423139032:1.source_cn: 谈判就是这样，只要对双方都有利可图，氛围便自然融洽。

say:39:1423139033:1.text: If there are no other issues, we can proceed and sign the agreement.
say:39:1423139033:1.source_cn: 如果没有异议的话，我们就签约吧。

narration:41:1423139034:0.text: Zanie and Ravion sign the official agreement for the collaboration between Brimstone Village and Sal'thorin on the production of arcane steel.
narration:41:1423139034:0.source_cn: 祖娅与沙利叶签订了深岩村与萨洛克兰共同开展一期魔钢合作...

say:42:1423139035:1.text: Phew... we've sealed the deal at last! I'm exhausted.
say:42:1423139035:1.source_cn: 呼……终于结束了！真是累人啊。

say:43:1423139036:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've played a big part in making this deal happen. Thanks!
say:43:1423139036:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've played a big part in making this deal happen. Thanks!
say:43:1423139036:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you've played a big part in making this deal happen. Thanks!

say:44:1423139037:1.text: We need to hurry back to the village! With the contract signed, busy days are ahead!
say:44:1423139037:1.source_cn: 矮人伙计们，抓紧时间回村吧，合约一签，村里就得忙起来了！

say:0:1423140001:0.text: I'll go back with you guys.
say:0:1423140001:0.male: I'll go back with you guys.
say:0:1423140001:0.female: I'll go back with you guys.

say:0:1423141001:0.text: There's someone getting off at the dock!
say:0:1423141001:0.source_cn: 码头那边好像有人来了！

say:1:1423141002:0.text: Oh? Let's check out the dock.
say:1:1423141002:0.source_cn: 码头来人了？希望是友非敌……去看看吧。
say:1:1423141002:0.male: Oh? Let's check out the dock.
say:1:1423141002:0.female: Oh? Let's check out the dock.

say:0:1423142001:0.source_cn: 那是……呼金！呼金居然回来了……

say:1:1423144001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Didn't expect to see you here!
say:1:1423144001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Didn't expect to see you here!
say:1:1423144001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Didn't expect to see you here!

say:2:1423144002:0.text: The village's in deep trouble this time, huh?
say:2:1423144002:0.source_cn: 看来村里果然出了大事啦。

choice_prompt:3:1423144002.text: The village's in deep trouble this time, huh?
choice_prompt:3:1423144002.source_cn: 看来村里果然出了大事啦。

say:4:1423144003:1.text: The shortage of echorites, the attempt to resurrect Helthor, and Eldric's conspiracy...
say:4:1423144003:1.source_cn: 深岩晶断供，复活赫托，弗林密谋叛变……

say:5:1423144004:1.text: This is way more serious than I thought!
say:5:1423144004:1.source_cn: 我是听说深岩村出事才回来的，但这可比我想得严重多啦！

choice_prompt:6:1423144004.text: This is way more serious than I thought!
choice_prompt:6:1423144004.source_cn: 我是听说深岩村出事才回来的，但这可比我想得严重多啦！

say:7:1423144005:1.text: Meet someone? Who is it? What's with all the mystery?
say:7:1423144005:1.source_cn: 见人？……见谁啊……搞得这么神秘。

say:8:1423144006:1.text: Anyway, I won't say no when it's <style="stress"><player_name></style> doing the talking!
say:8:1423144006:1.male: Anyway, I won't say no when it's <style="stress"><player_name></style> doing the talking!
say:8:1423144006:1.female: Anyway, I won't say no when it's <style="stress"><player_name></style> doing the talking!

choice:6:0:1.text: I'd like you to meet someone.
choice:6:0:1.male: I'd like you to meet someone.
choice:6:0:1.female: I'd like you to meet someone.

choice:3:0:1.text: Let me get you up to speed...
choice:3:0:1.male: Let me get you up to speed...
choice:3:0:1.female: Let me get you up to speed...

say:3:1423146002:0.text: Master Zanie! You haven't changed a bit!
say:3:1423146002:0.source_cn: 祖娅老师！你还是和以前一样啊！

say:4:1423146003:0.text: I'm afraid I can't say the same about you, Hugin. You were just a young kid when you left the village!
say:4:1423146003:0.source_cn: 呼金，你可是变了好多啊！你离开村子那会儿可还是个毛头小子！

say:5:1423146004:0.text: Even you're back... Things must be really bad in the village...
say:5:1423146004:0.source_cn: 村里的事都大到惊动你出山了吗……

say:6:1423146005:0.text: I'll be overseeing things in the village for now, at least until the situation improves.
say:6:1423146005:0.source_cn: 我得暂时当一段时间村里的负责人了，起码得把这个局面收拾...

say:7:1423146006:0.text: What made you come back all of a sudden? No way it's because you missed me, right?
say:7:1423146006:0.source_cn: 你怎么突然想起回村的？总不会是因为想我这个老人家吧！

say:8:1423146007:0.text: I heard things went awry at the village, so I made a trip back...
say:8:1423146007:0.source_cn: 我这次也是听说村子出了事，专程回来的……

say:9:1423146008:0.text: Oh, right! Let me introduce my companions! This is Hardhead, Whistler, and Shorty... Say hello to Master Zanie, guys!
say:9:1423146008:0.source_cn: 对了，祖娅老师！这是铁头，这是尖哨，这是矮地……来，跟...

narration:10:1423146009:0.text:
Hugin and Zanie start catching up on each other's lives...
Let's give them some space.
narration:10:1423146009:0.source_cn: 呼金和祖娅滔滔不绝地叙起了旧……\n让他们师徒单独相处...
